lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Performance task build: argument and presentation

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Set up the first two carefully; the rest of the build depends on them.

items.prompt: A data set has the values 38, 48, 58, 68, 78. The mean is 58. What is the mean absolute deviation (MAD), a measure of the data's uncertainty or spread?
A student claims a box that is 4 by 3 by 6 units has a volume of 13 cubic units. Evaluate the claim.
choices: Yes; the volume is 13 cubic units.
No; the volume is 14 cubic units, not 13.
No; the volume is 72 cubic units, not 13.
No; the volume is 15 cubic units, not 13.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A rental company charges a $2 base fee plus $6 per hour. A customer's total bill was $32. Which equation models this situation, and how many hours were rented?

A diver starts at the surface (0 m) and descends 8 m, then descends another 6 m, then ascends 6 m. The dive plan assumes a depth limit of 30 m below the surface. What is the diver's final position, as a signed number of meters?
A model predicts a $900 rate will increase by 20%. What does the model predict as the new rate?
A storage container is designed as a rectangular prism 12 ft long, 7 ft wide, and 8 ft high. What is its volume in cubic feet?
A data set has the values 62, 67, 72, 77, 82. The mean is 72. What is the mean absolute deviation (MAD), a measure of the data's uncertainty or spread?
A student claims a box that is 8 by 3 by 6 units has a volume of 17 cubic units. Evaluate the claim.
choices: No; the volume is 18 cubic units, not 17.
No; the volume is 144 cubic units, not 17.
Cannot be determined from the given information.
No; the volume is 19 cubic units, not 17.

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Carry the build to a result and state the check that would catch an error in it.

items.prompt: A rental company charges a $14 base fee plus $8 per hour. A customer's total bill was $126. Which equation models this situation, and how many hours were rented?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A diver starts at the surface (0 m) and descends 33 m, then descends another 17 m, then ascends 25 m. The dive plan assumes a depth limit of 66 m below the surface. What is the diver's final position, as a signed number of meters?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
